sloka: तद्राक्षसतनूजस्य छिन्नस्कन्धं शिरो महत्।तपनीयनिभं भूमौ ददृशे रुधिरोक्षितम् ।। ६.९१.७५ ।।
transliteration: tadrākṣasatanūjasya chinnaskandhaṁ śiro mahat।tapanīyanibhaṁ bhūmau dadṛśe rudhirokṣitam ।। 6.91.75 ।।

translations.english: Trunk broken off, the huge head of Indrajith bathed in blood was seen on the earth shining like gold.
